newsitem.title: USA: Aztec Manufacturing CEO says Q2 net higher.
newsitem.headline: Aztec Manufacturing CEO says Q2 net higher.

text.p: Aztec Manufacturing Co's net earnings were about $0.15 per share in the second quarter ended August 31, up from $0.10 a year earlier, Chairman, President and Chief Executive L.C. Martin told Reuters.
Martin said in a telephone interview that preliminary figures showed sales of about $13.5 million in the quarter, up from about $11 million in the same period last year.
"We are going to be looking at something like $875,000 net income after taxes," Martin said. That compares to $569,000 in the same period last year.
Aztec is to announce second quarter results on September 18.
